doc.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021

chapter: Daily life and the state of jazz
title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe praises Yanow's big ears, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation and I admire you for finding this career and sticking with it for so long, and what we call big ears between musicians and you obviously have big ears for all the styles and appreciate them. And I congratulate you for that.
Well thank you, well it’s great fun. I mean I have a 30-second commute to work. I could complain and say you have to listen to records all day long.
Well great. Thanks for your time today. I’m going to pause our recording and then we’ll say our good-byes.
Okay well thanks for having me, it’s been great fun. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
